name: ZENITH-1
author: Polystellarflow
tagline: Generative ambient worlds for the FM-1
description: ZENITH-1, by Polystellarflow, turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a generative ambient machine, built on AMB-1. It plays itself from the moment it's switched on: breathing pads that bloom, shimmering bells on tape loops of unequal length, a gliding bass, quiet Euclidean percussion and a soft texture of air, through a tape echo, a long tape loop and a shimmering plate. Left alone it travels through the parts of a world, from era to era and from world to world, never the same twice. Eight worlds, more than forty sounds, an FX menu of 24 effects, and full-screen pictures that move with the music.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, its engine, controls and structure; the picture from HADAL-1's; on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hugelton Instruments).
